rules.name: The Readable Color Rule
rules.body: Use dark text on light surfaces and warm white on navy. BRAND.md excludes gold and light gray as text; this page does not use gold.

rules.name: The Readable Body Rule
rules.body: Body copy stays at least 18px, with line-height at least 1.6 and weight at least 400. Compact wordmark lettering is identity treatment, not a body-copy size precedent.

keyCharacteristics: Navy framing with warm light surfaces.
Playfair Display headings and readable Inter body copy.
Text wordmark on new surfaces, generous controls, and visible keyboard focus.
narrative.overview: The established brand is warm, clear, reassuring, and credible. Spacious public pages support seniors and family caregivers with readable copy, human photography, and direct actions. This document records the approved press implementation; it does not introduce a new visual identity or replace BRAND.md, the canonical brand authority.
dos: Do preserve BRAND.md as the brand authority.
Do use readable body copy, visible keyboard focus, and controls at least 44px tall.
Do retain original photograph proportions and document asset provenance in the surface brief.
donts: Don't use gold or light gray as text.
Don't inherit older homepage logo or small-body-type drift into new surfaces.
Don't promote the press article's composition into a mandatory site-wide layout.

components.description: Original-article link with visible hover and keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 13px 20px; background: var(--navy, #0B1D3A); color: var(--white, #FDFBF8); border-radius: 6px; font: 500 18px/1.65 Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-primary:hover { background: var(--navy-light, #16304F); text-decoration: underline; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--teal, #276B6B); outline-offset: 5px; }
components.name: Primary action

components.description: Outlined consultation link within the navy navigation band.
components.css: .ds-header { background: var(--navy, #0B1D3A); padding: 20px; } .ds-consultation { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 16px; border: 1px solid #91A2B8; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--white, #FDFBF8); font: 500 18px/1.65 Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-consultation:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 8px; } .ds-consultation:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--white, #FDFBF8); outline-offset: 5px; }
components.name: Consultation outline

components.description: Navy header links with underlined current-page and hover states.
components.name: Header navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px 28px; padding: 26px 48px; background: var(--navy, #0B1D3A); } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--white, #FDFBF8); font: 500 18px/1.65 Inter, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current] { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 8px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--white, #FDFBF8); outline-offset: 5px; }
